design_notes.tensor_cut: extract_patches mirrors the certified-map D-map decomposition (rows decomposed along u by BSplineCurve::bezier_decomposition, then each u-piece's columns along v) over the homogeneous BSplineSurface<Vector4> carrier. Tensor cut operations commute across axes, so the result is exactly the Bezier patch grid; the Vector4 channels split into the numerator net A (x,y,z) and the weight net W (w). A span's Bernstein net is invariant under the affine source-to-unit re-parameterization, so the coefficients recorded are exactly the rectangle's Bezier net (no re-sampling).
design_notes.weight_bracket_certificate: per-span weight brackets are certified by the frozen TensorBernsteinPatch::try_new (axis hull = Bernstein hull of the weight coefficients, the convex-hull certificate). No new certificate code: a strictly positive weight net of an admissible face extracts to strictly positive span nets (knot insertion is convex), so no admissible face is refused; a non-certifiable face refuses InvalidInput (D-shim rule), never a silent non-positive weight.
design_notes.refusal_policy: extract_patches refuses InvalidInput on: empty/ragged/non-finite control nets, unclamped knot vectors (an unclamped face's end spans are not exact knot rectangles of a declared domain), degenerate knot ranges (fewer than two distinct knots per axis), and decomposition piece-count mismatches against the unique-knot grid. Parent identity: face ordinal 0 (single-face lemma; ADM-001 owns pair numbering), edge None (L1 has no BRep edge input).
design_notes.synthetic_fixtures: identity fixtures: bilinear (1,1) spline over [0,2]x[0,3] with interior single knots built from closed-form grid samples (degree-1 clamped splines interpolate their net); smooth biquadratic (2,2) spline over the same grid built from the closed form X(u,v)=(u,v,(u-1)^2+(v-1.5)^2) by the independent B-spline blossom map (coefficient = tensor blossom over consecutive knot windows, e_r/C(d,r) for the monomial u^p v^q); the biquadratic NURBS unit-sphere octant (genuinely rational, non-constant positive weights, |X|=1 invariant); and the rational multi-span face X = (w(u)Gamma(v))/w(u) = Gamma(v), Gamma(v)=(v^2,v,v), weight spline w(u)=(u-1)^2+1 (strictly positive) - weights vary across the u spans. Refusal fixture: single-span bilinear face with a negative homogeneous corner weight.
